fixture.equality_basis: Equal cumulative expenditure and prior history, not equal equipped price. Shared inventory W_FLOW/W_ECHO/A_EMBER costs104; VITALITY1 costs20; two offensive axes at rank2 cost110; branch costs60.
fixture.history: Six prior levelups through add_levelup; temple SUCCESS earned100 then jungle SUCCESS earned100 through settle; each awards150 including success20/first-clear30.

measurement_notes: Attack/slash starts use existing sequence counters. Hitting actions and refund triggers are deduplicated per sequence; cooldown floors mean a trigger is not necessarily a full0.22s effective reduction; hit_targets count target events, not attacks. Wisp hits include projectile/chain/orbit events and are not shot accuracy. Requests failing to produce an action within0.4 active seconds are separate from actions; end-pending requests remain separate. No forced cards/XP, rerolls, damage tuning, health restoration or growth caps. First life only. Tactical policies are scripted assumptions. Unsettled limits are IN_PROGRESS, never economy settlement proof.
